## 2024-05-14 - Keyboard Accessibility for Scrollable Containers
**Learning:** HTML reports generated by Python contain scrollable wrapper `div`s (`overflow: auto`) for wide content like SVG charts and datatables. These were not keyboard accessible. When a container relies on CSS `overflow` to be scrollable but contains no natively focusable elements, keyboard users cannot scroll it. We need explicit `tabindex="0"`, `role="region"`, and an `aria-label`.
**Action:** When creating or modifying scrollable containers (`overflow: auto` or `scroll`) in HTML reports, always ensure they are keyboard focusable by adding `tabindex="0"`, `role="region"`, an `aria-label`, and a visible `:focus-visible` CSS rule.
